definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers medical expenses. In Japan, enrollment in a public health insurance system is mandatory for all residents. The two main types are employee health insurance (社会保険) and National Health Insurance (国民健康保険).

examples.japanese: {健康保険|けんこうほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する。
{健康保険|けんこうほけん}{証|しょう}を{忘|わす}れずにお{持|も}ちください。
examples.english: Please don't forget to bring your health insurance card.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{全員|ぜんいん}が{何|なん}らかの{健康保険|けんこうほけん}に{入|はい}ることが{義務|ぎむ}づけられている。
examples.english: In Japan, everyone is required to be enrolled in some form of health insurance.

notes: Often abbreviated to {健保|けんぽ}. Key related terms: {健康保険|けんこうほけん}{証|しょう} (health insurance card), {国民健康保険|こくみんけんこうほけん} (National Health Insurance, often abbreviated {国保|こくほ}), {社会保険|しゃかいほけん} (employee social insurance). In Japan, the standard copay is 30% of medical costs, with the insurance covering the remaining 70%.
